Based on the search results, here's what I found about "dssharness claude code probe":

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) is an MIT-licensed, fully open-source agent harness, while Claude Code is Anthropic's official closed-source coding agent. The two tools have different extension mechanisms and can work together in various ways.

The "Probe" skill allows you to consult shared Claude Code probe results or test Claude Code harness behavior through a real interactive session. Probe is available as a Claude Code skill that can be installed via npx command.

One interesting capability is that dsh can delegate tasks to Claude Code as a sub-agent, and can also directly reuse a Claude Code hooks.json file. Both tools support bridging Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, using a similar naming convention for tools (mcp__<serverName>__<rawName>).

The search results indicate these are tools used in AI development workflows, with the "probe" being a testing and verification skill specifically designed for Claude Code harnesses.
